4PrintShops - bundled document conversion component

This package contains an unmodified LibreOffice 26.8.2.2 Windows x64 binary
distribution by The Document Foundation and its contributors, repackaged for
private, local document conversion. LibreOffice is not authored by 4PrintShops.
No endorsement by The Document Foundation is implied.

Original LICENSE.html, license.txt, NOTICE, CREDITS.fodt and readmes are retained
in this directory. These contain the applicable MPL 2.0 and third-party license
notices, including notices for libraries and fonts. All copyright notices and
applicable redistribution terms remain in force.

The binaries are copied from the official MSI without code modifications.
The x64 runtime libraries originally in the administrative image's System64
directory are copied beside the program; its Fonts directory is copied to
share/fonts/truetype. No libraries or fonts are installed in Windows by the
4PrintShops installer. No Office file associations or LibreOffice shortcuts are
registered. Conversion uses a separate temporary user profile.

Corresponding LibreOffice source archives, exact URLs, build identifier and
SHA256 checksums are listed in SOURCE-CODE.json alongside this notice.
The publisher keeps verified source archives in its local build cache; these
archives are separate from the application installer. Third-party source and
license details are also documented in the retained original license files
and the LibreOffice source tree. Source must remain available to recipients
under the applicable licenses when this component is redistributed.

LibreOffice trademarks remain the property of their respective owners.
See https://www.libreoffice.org/licenses/ for project licensing information.
